Exact row quoted: "2026-02-28 | APTIV COMPONENTS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | CEER NATIONAL AUTOMOTIVE COMPANY, APTIV PART NUMBER. 36061954 HARN CONSOLE WIRING PO No. 5500000138 ... | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Jeddah, SAUDI ARABIA | 85443000 | 1134158". Further rows same date/destination/BOL 1134158 (HS 85443000, wiring harnesses). Other confirmed buyer lanes: PT APTIV COMPONENTS INDONESIA (3672 shipments), APTIV KOREA LLC (759), CYPRIUM KOREA LLC (228). Source counter: page claims 150921 total shipments; rows actually visible on the free page = 4 export rows (all 2026-02-28, Nhava Sheva -> Jeddah, SA, HS 85443000, BOL 1134158) plus aggregated partner/port counters (604 trading partners, 174 ports). Only the 4 rows are individually verifiable; the 150921 figure is a platform counter, not independently audited.
domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report India split could be retrieved within the tool budget: thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) for the query "Aptiv Components India" GST turnover GeM tender contract Chennai. Domestic supply is therefore not evidenced either way — null, not public in the sources reachable.
note: Entity resolution: the four names in the input are one and the same Indian legal entity — Aptiv Components India Private Limited is the post-2017 spin-off/rename of Delphi Automotive Systems (India). ImportKey has a populated record only under the Aptiv name; the legacy slugs /delphi-automotive-systems-pvt-ltd and /delphi-automotive-systems-limited both returned zero shipment rows ("Loading..." placeholder, no records, no partners, no ports), i.e. the Delphi names are historical aliases, not separate live shippers. HS DISCREPANCY: declared HS 851779 (telecom/electronics parts) does not match the actual customs HS on every visible record — 85443000 (insulated wiring harnesses for motor vehicles). Per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection: the company stays in the base, the code is corrected to the factual 85443000, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry label "IT и электроника" is also inaccurate — actual activity is automotive wiring harness / electrical distribution systems manufacturing. Export factuality: real, dated, destination-specific customs shipments are confirmed (2026-02-28, Nhava Sheva -> Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, buyer CEER National Automotive Company, BOL 1134158) — this is a customs record, not a website claim. Domestic supply: no evidence found in reachable sources; recorded as unknown/null rather than asserted. No sanctions/court/ownership issues were researched (out of scope for this role and not a rejection ground per rule 2). Revenue and export volume in value terms: null — not public on the free views.
